title: Languages can bring people together
summaryZh: 从欧洲语言日了解欧洲的语言多样性及学习语言的意义。原报道发表于2026年9月26日，本篇于10月10日整理供学习，并非当日新闻。

sentences.text: More than 200 languages are spoken across Europe.
sentences.zh: 欧洲各地使用的语言超过200种。

sentences.text: The European Union has 24 official languages, as well as more than 60 regional and minority languages.
sentences.zh: 欧盟有24种官方语言，以及60多种地区语言和少数群体语言。

sentences.text: The European Day of Languages celebrates this diversity on 26 September each year.
sentences.zh: 每年9月26日，欧洲语言日庆祝这种多样性。

sentences.text: The day began in 2001, and people also celebrate it outside the European Union.
sentences.zh: 这个纪念日始于2001年，欧盟以外的人们也庆祝它。

sentences.text: In an article published on 26 September 2026, the European Commission explains why learning languages matters.
sentences.zh: 在2026年9月26日发表的一篇文章中，欧盟委员会解释了学习语言的重要性。

sentences.text: It says that languages can build connections between people and cultures.
sentences.zh: 委员会指出，语言可以在人们和文化之间建立联系。

sentences.text: Knowing several languages can support personal development and open up new career opportunities.
sentences.zh: 掌握多种语言有助于个人发展，并带来新的职业机会。

sentences.text: The Commission also describes language diversity as part of Europe’s shared heritage.
sentences.zh: 委员会还将语言多样性视为欧洲共同遗产的一部分。

sentences.text: The theme for 2026 highlights the way languages bring people together.
sentences.zh: 2026年的主题强调语言如何将人们联系起来。

sentences.text: The article links language learning with inclusion, democracy and a stronger sense of connection within society.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章将语言学习与包容、民主，以及社会内部更强的联系感联系起来。
